origin.description: Turns a covariance or correlation into partial correlations.

arguments.name: tol
arguments.text: Singular values at or below tol are dropped. The default follows the matrix size and the largest singular value.

origin.details: The inverse is the Moore-Penrose inverse, so a singular matrix is allowed. The diagonal of the precision is restored before rescaling.
